_comment: First-run setup recommendations (crates/grid-core/src/launch/setup.rs). 'recommended' maps a RomM platform slug to emulator profile names in order of preference; the first one installable on this OS is pre-selected. A platform not listed here takes the keyword-matched standalone emulators in name order. RetroArch is never listed: setup uses it only for platforms with no standalone emulator, and only when a core is known for the platform. 'not_offered' names profiles setup never shows.
